acceptance_criteria: Every declared flow concept appears in the resolved plan as a reference to an existing semantic entity, with no new top-level kind.

Every declared core parameter of the selected System and of each referenced Component appears in the resolved plan at the frozen mapping location (components[].declaredParameters); a System-level parameter is never silently dropped, including when a Component parameter is projected.
Unknown namespaces or unknown fields fail closed with a stable structured diagnostic.
The five existing XDL resource kinds remain unchanged and compatible.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.

review_resolution.note: Successor correction: the predecessor froze the Component/System parameter mapping but silently dropped System.spec.parameters; the amended statement and second acceptance criterion now forbid any silent parameter omission.

statement: The compiler shall compile declared System, Component, Interface, Endpoint, and flow intent into the resolved plan using the existing XDL v1alpha1 System and Component semantic entities, and shall not introduce a new top-level XDL resource kind or a competing configuration language; every declared core parameter of the selected System and of each referenced Component shall be projected into the resolved plan by the frozen concept-to-field mapping, and no declared parameter may be silently omitted.
title: Logical system/component/flow intent mapped to existing resource kinds
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
